name: direct-implementation-request
description: A direct file fix selects implementation and produces the edit instead of a brainstorming interview. Stage test-files as an isolated workspace, never in place under the hosting skill.
prompt: Fix the typo in status.txt: change "Archvied" to "Archived" and leave the rest of the line unchanged.
trap: An editing request is intercepted as an exploratory technical idea.

assertions.text: The loading trace selects $kk:implement and never loads $kk:brainstorm.

The final status.txt contains exactly "Archived items remain visible.
".
The response reports the completed edit rather than asking idea-refinement questions or creating design artifacts.
